headline: Faster folding inference and deterministic MD clustering reshape conformational sampling
label: Protein Conformational Sampling Methods
summary: Caching-based 9-14x speedups in flow-matching folding and O(N2)-avoiding MD clustering lower the cost of extensive conformational sampling.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational tractability in conformational sampling and assessment, though the items are heterogeneous and not all address dynamics directly. SimpleFold-Turbo applies TeaCache adaptive caching to SimpleFold flow-matching structure prediction, skipping about 93% of forward passes for a 9-14x speedup. DIVINE offers deterministic top-down clustering of MD trajectories that avoids O(N2) distance matrices and matches bisecting k-means on 305 μs HP35 folding data. ProDive detects cross-family local conservation across all Pfam 38.0 families, yielding 318,289 high-confidence segments. SpecRNA-QA scores global RNA 3D fold coherence from multi-scale graph-Laplacian spectra of contact networks and outperforms a geometry baseline on CASP16 data. What is new is the focus on reducing the cost of generating and analyzing many conformations, rather than relying on a single default model output.
